text:
Source-assisted reading (research reader), made on the native images after the image-only first reading stams5-2026-11-01-image-only, with Peter Lombard, Commentarium in Psalmos (PL 191, cols. 1168-1170) in hand; not blind.
All four piece-faces were reread on the image: the two strips rotated 180 degrees, the verse 4 and verse 6 lines again at higher zoom, and the lowest lines of the canvas 1 piece contrast-enhanced.
Lines read by the independent checker (lower half of the canvas 1 piece and tab) are given in the report, not here, except where noted.

Images:
- canvas 0: https://fragmentarium.ms/loris/F-e8dj/Stams_STA_Frg_146_01r02r.jpg
- canvas 1: https://fragmentarium.ms/loris/F-e8dj/Stams_STA_Frg_146_01v02v.jpg
Both are 7360 x 4912.

Conventions:
- Regions are x,y,width,height in native pixels.
- Expansions are in ( ).
- ? marks an uncertain reading.
- [ ] marks text lost at the edge or supplied for sense; [...] is lost text.
- <u> </u> marks red underlining.

FACE X

A. Strip, canvas 1, 2760,1920,1100,760 (upside down; read rotated). Red "ac" marks in the margin.
1 [quasi] expauescens exclamat. o d(omi)ne si i[niquitatem]
2 [...] obserua[ueris] i(d est) ad uindictam (a)eternam serua[ueris]
3 [...] q(ui)s sustinebit te iudice(m)? Nullus. N(on) t(antu)m ego
4 [...] n(on) sustinebo. s(ed) q(ui)s sustinebit? q(uia) p(ro)pe o(mn)is h[umana]
5 uita peccatis suis c(ir)c(um)latrat(ur) (et)? ..q(ue)? (con)scientia
6 [...]nib(us) accusat(ur). n(on) e(st) en(im) castu(m) cor q(uod)
7 [de iu]sticia sua p(re)sumat. [...] de dei m(isericord)ia .s.
8 [...]pitiatio. Un(de) subd(it). <u>Quia ap(ud) te</u>
